post.description: Find trademark serial numbers by mark text; for brand screening use `match: phrase` with `status` and `classes` to isolate live marks in the relevant classes. Pass `hits[].serial_number` to `trademark_status` or `assignments`.

alive.description: Older live/dead filter: true is `status: live`, false is `status: dead`. Prefer `status`; when both are given they must agree.

classes.description: Nice international classes; a mark matches when it lists any of them, e.g. `[41]` (education and entertainment) or `[9, 16, 41]` (books and publishing). Classes the registration has since deleted, shown as `(CANCELLED) IC 041`, still match, as on the site.

from.description:
Zero-based offset; pass the previous page's `next_from`.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 9900; default 0.

match.description:
`basic`: the site's basic word-mark search (phrase or any word in the mark, phrase in the pseudo mark). `phrase`: only marks whose word mark or pseudo mark contains the text as a phrase, e.g. `galaxy sports` finds GALAXY SPORTS but not SPORTS GALAXY. Default: `phrase` for a quoted text, else `basic`.

Provider reference: allowed values ["basic", "phrase"].

owner.description: Owner (applicant or registrant) name phrase, matched with up to two words between terms as the site's owner search does, e.g. `samsung electronics`.

size.description:
size

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

status.description:
Status filter as the site defines it: `live` (registered or pending), `registered` (live with a registration number), `pending` (live application without one), `dead` (cancelled or abandoned), `cancelled` (dead with a cancellation date), `abandoned` (dead with an abandonment date). Omitted: all.

Provider reference: allowed values ["live", "registered", "pending", "dead", "cancelled", "abandoned"].

text.description: Word mark text to search, e.g. `firecrawl`. Wrapping it in double quotes (`"night hand"`) defaults `match` to `phrase`; the quotes are not sent.

Frequently asked questions about FireCrawl
What is FireCrawl?
FireCrawl is an advanced web crawling and data conversion tool designed to transform any website into clean, LLM-ready markdown. Ideal for AI developers and data scientists, it automates the collection, cleaning, and formatting of web data, streamlining the preparation process for Large Language Model (LLM) applications.
How does FireCrawl handle dynamic content on websites?
Unlike traditional web scrapers, FireCrawl is equipped to handle dynamic content rendered with JavaScript. It ensures comprehensive data collection from all accessible subpages, making it a reliable tool for scraping websites that rely heavily on JS for content delivery.
Can FireCrawl crawl websites without a sitemap?
Yes, FireCrawl can access and crawl all accessible subpages of a website, even in the absence of a sitemap. This feature enables users to gather data from a wide array of web sources with minimal setup.
What formats can FireCrawl convert web data into?
FireCrawl specializes in converting web data into clean, well-formatted markdown. This format is particularly suited for LLM applications, offering a structured yet flexible way to represent web content.
How does FireCrawl ensure the cleanliness of the data?
FireCrawl employs advanced algorithms to clean and structure the scraped data, removing unnecessary elements and formatting the content into readable markdown. This process ensures that the data is ready for use in LLM applications without further preprocessing.
Is FireCrawl suitable for large-scale data scraping projects?
Absolutely. FireCrawl offers various pricing plans, including a Scale plan that supports scraping of millions of pages. With features like caching and scheduled syncs, it's designed to efficiently handle large-scale data scraping and continuous updates, making it ideal for enterprises and large projects.
What measures does FireCrawl take to handle web scraping challenges like rate limits and caching?
FireCrawl is built to navigate common web scraping challenges, including reverse proxies, rate limits, and caching. It smartly manages requests and employs caching techniques to minimize bandwidth usage and avoid triggering anti-scraping mechanisms, ensuring reliable data collection.
How can I try FireCrawl?
You can start with FireCrawl by trying our free trial, which includes 100 pages. This trial allows you to experience firsthand how FireCrawl can streamline your data collection and conversion processes. Sign up and begin transforming web content into LLM-ready data today!
Who can benefit from using FireCrawl?
FireCrawl is tailored for LLM engineers, data scientists, AI researchers, and developers looking to harness web data for training machine learning models, market research, content aggregation, and more. It simplifies the data preparation process, allowing professionals to focus on insights and model development.

post.description: You have a barcode (or a world.openfoodfacts.org product URL) and want its nutrition facts, ingredients, allergens or scores. Use `search` first when you only know a name or brand.

barcode.description: Product barcode: GTIN-8/12/13/14 (EAN, UPC) as digits, leading zeros kept. Open Food Facts normalises codes, so the returned `barcode` may carry extra leading zeros. Exactly one of `barcode` or `url`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{8,14}$.

country.description: Two-letter country code (`cc`) the site uses for country-dependent computations such as the Nutri-Score comparison country; default `us`. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

lang.description: Two-letter language code (`lc`) for localised names; default `en`. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

url.description: A product page URL on any Open Food Facts country site, e.g. https://world.openfoodfacts.org/product/5449000000996/coca-cola or https://fr.openfoodfacts.org/produit/5449000000996. The barcode is taken from the path.

sections.heading: WoW Forever Warrior Talent Calculator
paragraphs: The talent calculator below shows the three talent trees for the Warrior class in WoW Forever.
Use the left mouse button to invest talent points in Arms, Fury, and Protection. Use the right mouse button to remove talent points.

sections.heading: Warrior Builds in WoW Forever
paragraphs: Builds and specs for Warrior in WoW Forever are coming soon. Use our calculator to plan your WoW Forever talents today.

sections.heading: Warrior Changes in WoW Forever
items: Victory Rush: Warriors gain Victory Rush, giving them an additional attack after defeating an enemy and improving their ability to continue fighting while leveling and questing.
Shorter major cooldowns: The long cooldowns on major Warrior abilities such as Recklessness, Retaliation, and Shield Wall are reduced from 30 minutes to 15 minutes.
Improved Protection gameplay: Protection receives several talent changes intended to make deep Protection builds more competitive, including additional offensive options further down the talent tree.
Less stance switching for Protection: Protection Warriors can gain access to abilities such as Charge and Thunder Clap while in Defensive Stance, reducing the need to switch stances.

More damage options for tanks: The reworked Protection tree includes stronger damage-oriented talents alongside its defensive and threat talents, giving tank-focused Warriors more ways to improve their damage without relying as heavily on Fury/Protection hybrid builds.
Skyborne Warriors: The new Skyborne race can play Warrior on both the Alliance and Horde, adding a new playable race option for the class. Learn here how to unlock the Skyborne race in WoW Forever.
paragraphs: Warriors receive several changes in WoW Forever, including reworked talent trees, a new ability, shorter major cooldowns, and improvements to Protection gameplay. Arms, Fury, and Protection retain the stance-based, Rage-driven gameplay of Vanilla WoW, but several changes are designed to make the class less restrictive and give deep Protection builds more options. Blizzard has confirmed that Forever classes will receive new abilities and talent updates, while many of the Warrior-specific details below come from the playable BlizzCon 2026 demo and may still change before release.
